title: Erasing Concepts, Steering Generations: A Comprehensive Survey of Concept Suppression

bias_targets.methodology: As a comprehensive survey on concept erasure, the paper reviews text-to-image (T2I) benchmarks like T2ISafety that quantify fairness and societal bias using safety rates and KL divergence metrics.
